lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: Hi

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: You're a friend of Seimeikai's leader, right?

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: I saw you two chatting, and you seemed friendly enough.
The leader of the Seimeikai?
Yes, I know her.

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: You might know her as Sakura.

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: Great.

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: I'm glad my informant gave me the right number.

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: I realize you don't know me,

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: but I have a request.

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: How much do you know about the Seimeikai?
They're one of the top three largest underground organizations.
They're a weirdo cult where everyone dresses up in suits.

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: So you do know.

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: Well, there's an internal conflict brewing within their ranks.

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: If it boils over, I shouldn't have to tell you how detrimental that could be to the current state of peace in the Ark.

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: You're not entirely wrong.

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: Anyway, there's an internal conflict brewing within their ranks.

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: Worst comes to worst, their leadership may end up changing.

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: If that happens, it'll be chaos.

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: People like me who are low on the totem pole will drop like flies.
What do you want me to do?
Are you one of the Seimeikai?

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: Something which is difficult, but needs to be done.

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: No comment.

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: If one of them caught wind of me getting in touch with you,

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: I shudder to think what would happen to me.

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: So can you do it or not?
Let's hear your plan first.

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: You'll use your pre-existing friendship with Sakura to gain access to the Seimeikai.

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: I want you to mediate the relationship between Sakura and the opposing organizations.

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: None of these groups will exactly roll out the red carpet for a stranger,

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: but they won't harm any personnel from the Central Government either.
If it will help out Sakura, I'll do it.

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: kitsune
lines.text: I'll leave the rest to you.
